title: High-Precision Dichotomous Image Segmentation via Probing Diffusion Capacity (DiffDIS)
mechanism: Fine-tunes the Stable Diffusion 2.1 U-Net for one-step mask denoising with an auxiliary edge-generation task for fine-grained high-resolution segmentation.
evidence: R: SOTA on DIS5K (abstract, no numbers on page).
adaptation: Moonshot: condition SD on [EL replicated, house p(crack)] at 512 px, one step; tests whether a large generative prior recovers faint cracks; needs weight download approval.
min_experiment: Arm: DiffDIS-style refiner. Baseline: house ensemble. Metric: relR@2 at fixed relP@2. Kill: relR@2 < +0.01.
